nominee.longerDescription: Happy Woman Crush Wednesday! She's a Twitch streamer, but since I don't watch Twitch nowadays I found her through her IG Reels, which are usually tips or fun facts about the games she likes (Stardew Valley, Minecraft, etc.). Her videos are cool but obviously I stayed because I looked at her and went "zamn, who's this fine shyt 😛". As I was looking for pictures I noticed one where's she's the spitting image of a younger Vöri (1st pic), the others didn't really got me thinking that. She's "Award-winning" because on this year's Streamer Awards she won in the "Cozy" category! And I love women with achievements 😛. Also under her post about this year's European TwitchCon, Shubble commented something among the lines of "it was so fun to spend some time together", and that was the comment that made me realize that Shubble always comes to the European one as well! Really making me motivated to go to Berlin next year, although if I saw both of them at once I'm not sure if I could keep my consciousness! (You're not interested in coming, right? I'm pretty sure I understood you correctly, just making sure)
